tools.name: get_endpoint_history
tools.description: agentscan: presence and price history of ONE indexed record. Input: `source` and `id`, or `url`. Returns the record plus its dated presence rows and the points where its price changed over time. Typically 0.1-2 s. Price: USD 0.05. Free: 5 history lookups per IP per UTC day. Records not in the index

tools.description: agentscan: Test an x402 payment end to end: payer, network, tx, timings, signed UTC receipt. tools.name: check_mcp_server
tools.description: agentscan: Check whether a remote MCP server is up and what it offers. Returns a live check of a public remote MCP server: answers or not, name, version, protocol, sign-in needed, tool count and names, latency, TLS expiry, status class. Input: `url`, the public https URL of the MCP server endpoint.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_mcp_server" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: agentscan: Check whether a remote MCP server is up and what it offers. Returns a live check of a public remote MCP server: answers or not, name, version, protoc…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agents" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_endpoint_history, get_x402_bazaar_pulse, check_mcp_server · Private data: query_agent_index, get_endpoint_history, export_agent_index, bulk_agent_index, check_mcp_server, scan_agent_package · Public sink: test_x402_payment, scan_agent_package · Destructive: export_agent_index, test_x402_payment, scan_agent_package.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_endpoint_history, get_x402_bazaar_pulse, check_mcp_server · Private data: query_agent_index, get_endpoint_history, export_agent_index, bulk_agent_index, check_mcp_server, scan_agent_package · Public sink: test_x402_payment, scan_agent_package · Destructive: export_agent_index, test_x402_payment, scan_agent_package

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "query_agent_index" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
